method_limits: a module constant is followed at module scope only: a name rebound inside a function is not part of what the surface module publishes
aliases stay inside the module and cycles stop the walk; a call into another module crosses once and stops, so the published origin names the dependency instead of resolving the whole tree
readable_by_an_adapter_that_imports_only_the_surface_module is about the import edge, not about side effects: a tree walk is reachable but not frozen
the upstream face's own kind labels are taken as given; this study does not re-derive whether a site really passes a module constant
